cards.claim: St. John's Evangelical Lutheran Church was built in 1901-1902.
cards.quote: It was built in 1901-1902 and is a brick building with a medium pitched gable roof, deep bracketed cornice, and semi-engaged tower in the center bay of the front facade in the Late Gothic Revival style church.

cards.claim: St. John's Evangelical Lutheran Church's present large church building was constructed in the 1890s.
cards.quote: Founded as a German-speaking parish in Springfield's early days, it grew rapidly during its first few decades, and its present large church building was constructed in the 1890s under the direction of one of Springfield's leading architects.

cards.claim: St. John's Evangelical Lutheran Church was built in the 1890s.
cards.quote: [ 7 ] Since construction in the 1890s , it has been one of Springfield 's most distinctive buildings , due in large part to its two front towers — the bell tower is 135 feet ( 41 m ) high , and the principal tower 184 feet ( 56 m ) .

cards.claim: The first church structure of St. John's Evangelical Lutheran Church was built in October 1860.
cards.quote: This congregation built its first church structure, a wooden building nicknamed the "Church in the Timber," in October 1860 at Hemme's Landing next to the Missouri River, approximately two miles from Corning.

cards.claim: St. John's Evangelical Lutheran Church was built in 1893.
cards.quote: A new brick church was built in 1893 , but in May 1910 , lightning struck the edifice resulting in fire gutting the building .
